unit.title: Shapes
unit.blurb: Naming and describing 2D shapes by their sides and corners, and 3D shapes by how they roll and stack.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Name and describe 2D shapes: circle, triangle, square and rectangle.

O2.t: Name 3D shapes: cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder and cone.

p: A **circle** is round. A **triangle** has 3 straight sides. A **square** has 4 sides all the same length. A **rectangle** has 4 sides: two long and two short.
A triangle is still a triangle when you turn it upside down.

vocab.def: a straight edge of a shape

p: A ball is a **sphere**. A dice is a **cube**. A tin is a **cylinder**. An ice-cream cone is a **cone**. A cereal box is a **cuboid**.
Shapes with **curved** surfaces can **roll** (sphere, cylinder). Shapes with **flat** faces can **stack** (cube, cuboid). A cylinder can do both.

options.fb: A sphere is round like a ball.
